source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to attack the next worthwhile LeanFrontier target without prescribing a theorem. Direction D asks for the Galois and quadratic-subfield structure of the eighth cyclotomic field and explicitly prefers generic cyclotomic Galois machinery over generator arithmetic. The producer selected the structural center of that direction: prove that Gal(Q(zeta_8)/Q) is a Klein four group. The proof shows that (ZMod 8)^* has cardinality four and exponent two, then transports these invariants through Mathlib's galEquivZMod. The module also exposes a noncanonical group isomorphism to Multiplicative (ZMod 2 x ZMod 2) for the next subgroup-lattice/Galois-correspondence step. Searches found no existing LeanFrontier or Mathlib theorem packaging this specific Galois group as IsKleinFour. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and authored the Lean definitions, statement, and proof; the human did not author or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
